source.name: Football Shirt Culture: New Zealand 2026 Puma Home Kit
source.quote: Puma have revealed the New Zealand 2026 home kit, set to be worn by the New Zealand men’s national team during the 2026–2027 international cycle, including the 2026 FIFA World Cup
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The same article lists every mark on the black home shirt: 'A white Puma logo appears on the right chest, balanced by the silver fern crest on the left.' 'On the reverse, “Aotearoa” is positioned below the back collar in white lettering' and 'A small circular Puma authenticity mark is placed near the lower front hem.' Puma's US shop also calls the black shirt 'New Zealand Home'.

summary: Nothing on the shirt but the fern: Puma's black 2026 home shirt carries no commercial sponsors, only the Puma logo, the New Zealand Football silver-fern crest, 'Aotearoa' below the back collar and Puma's authenticity mark (Football Shirt Culture's launch description).
